q: How does a shipper count emissions from moving LPG by bullet tanker?
title: LPG bullet tankers: transport emissions
short: Multiply tonnes of LPG carried by road kilometres and a published intensity for the truck class, or use the trip's actual diesel if the transporter shares it. The shipper reports it as Scope 3 transport.
audience: LPG bottlers, distributors and industrial buyers moving gas by road tanker

p: Fuel-based: diesel litres for the trip x 2.68, if the transporter gives them.
Distance-based: tonnes x km x the intensity for the truck class.
Published averages already include typical empty running. Do not add the return leg again unless you use actual fuel.

example.title: Worked example: one trip, distance method (illustrative load and distance)
example.note: Load and distance are illustrative; 0.0663 kg CO2e per tonne-km is the SFC India default for 30 to 50 tonne trucks.
